global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender noodles, topped with crisp menma and fresh green garnish. The white ceramic bowl sits on a dark tray, illuminated warmly, highlighting the broth’s inviting sheen and the toppings’ neat arrangement.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and slight sheen, showing natural wood texture.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green leaf and sliced onion, shows rich brown color and glossy surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with a smooth, glossy surface and a slightly worn, beige-tinted tip.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as brown, slightly translucent, curved strips with visible fibrous texture and subtle surface ridges.
